description: Clean 5-seed Caliper sweep on 5-orderer Raft cluster. Each seed runs on a FRESH bootstrapped network (cryptogen + genesis + container start + chaincode deploy) to avoid the cumulative state-DB growth that broke seeds 2-5 in the original β sweep.

key_findings.rate-500_validated_5_seeds: Original β saw 483.7 TPS in seed 1 only; η confirms 468.4 TPS sustained across 5 fresh seeds
key_findings.fresh_network_strategy_works: State-DB bottleneck of original β fully avoided

related_phases.beta: 5node_caliper_2026-06-07 (failed multi-seed precursor; eta uses fresh-network-per-seed to fix)
related_phases.delta: 5node_saturation_delta_2026-06-08 (extends eta's rate-500 ceiling at 468.4 TPS to identify the actual saturation plateau)

paper_integration.delta_extension: Eta's rate-500 sustains 468 TPS at 50ms latency. Delta brackets the saturation by sweeping rate-600 through rate-900, finding the plateau at 503-537 TPS with latency growing 5.7s -> 17s as queue accumulates.
